vocabulary.definition: Versioned canonical representation of one poker hand independent of source text/provider.
Immutable legal game state immediately before one actor chooses an action.
A decision state where a statistic could legally occur and therefore belongs in its denominator.
Versioned opportunity predicate, success predicate, measure, and dimensions.
Probability/frequency weights over legal two-card Holdem combinations after known-card removal.
Versioned analytical input combining state, hero info, ranges, stats, strategy sources, and assumptions.
Theoretical/imported/solver strategy before player-specific exploit adjustments.
Bounded strategy change justified by opponent/population evidence and confidence thresholds.
Expected value under explicit range/branch/value assumptions; not guaranteed realized profit.
Source, solver/import version, abstraction, parameters, checksum, and approximation status for strategy data.

relationships.relationship: Raw source -> NormalizedHand -> DecisionSnapshots -> derived opportunities/features -> stats/ranges/equity -> DecisionSpot -> strategy/EV analysis -> HUD/replay/training artifacts.
PlayerProfile aggregates version-compatible StatisticDefinitions; PopulationPrior may inform sparse PlayerProfile posterior estimates.
A recommendation may combine BaselineStrategy and ExploitAdjustment but must retain both components separately.

invariants: A physical card cannot appear in more than one known location within a hand state.
Authoritative chip accounting conserves contributions and returns except for an explicitly modeled rake/fee transfer.
A statistic success can occur only inside its opportunity set; denominators are never substituted with total hands unless the definition explicitly says so.
Weighted ranges assign zero mass to impossible combos containing known dead cards.
Equity/probability/frequency values remain in [0,1] within numerical tolerance and multiway showdown shares sum to 1.
Every approximate solver or inferred strategy output carries provenance and may not be labeled exact equilibrium/GTO.
Every recommendation is reproducible from immutable inputs plus versioned strategy/model artifacts and seeds.
Realized financial outcome and modeled decision quality are stored/reported as different concepts.
